desc: 腰贴式侧贴结构，弹力腰围加双层防漏边，轻薄干爽不勒
name: 薄荷绿腰贴式透气尿裤款

shots.intent: 搜索首图，一眼看清腰贴式结构与干净色族，建立温和可靠的第一印象
把夜里侧漏、腰围勒红的顾虑摆上台面，用结构剖面承接而非恐吓画面
shots.textZone: top center headline, left column crop labels, right column three icon labels

shots.intent: 用结构对照说明腰贴式在贴合与防漏上的做法差异，不比较任何品牌
shots.textZone: top headline, one label under each of the two columns

shots.intent: 把腰围贴合的柔软感放进真实爬行场景，用背影与成人托抱保证安全合规
shots.textZone: bottom left, one short headline only

shots.intent: 微距证明腰围弹力与双层防漏边的真实做工，手感差异一眼可辨
把尿显条与卷起粘贴丢弃两处贴心设计讲明白，解决更换与收拾的实际麻烦
shots.textZone: top center headline, two panel labels at the bottom

shots.intent: 给出腰贴式与裤型两种穿着方式的选择指引，降低选错款的下单犹豫
shots.textZone: top headline, one label per card

shots.intent: 用最平静的一屏收口，留出干净文案位承接加购动作
shots.textZone: top center headline plus one short button label below the product

style.backgroundSystem: quilted cotton crawling mat in #FFFFFF and #F2F9F5 with a white playpen fence edge softly out of focus, shallow depth of field, no horizon line
style.iconSystem: terracotta pink #D98C7A thin-line leaf-shaped icons, 1.5pt stroke, flat, no filled shapes
style.lightingSystem: soft 5100K overhead light, nearly shadowless, only a gentle contact shadow, calm and clean mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft family-care baby commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, pale mint white #F2F9F5, mint green #A8D8C8 and one terracotta pink accent #D98C7A, text #3F5350; neutral temperature; modern rounded sans-serif; quilted cotton crawling-mat surface with a white playpen fence edge in the background; soft 5100K overhead light with almost no shadow; terracotta pink thin-line leaf-shaped icons; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no palette changes outside #FFFFFF #F2F9F5 #A8D8C8 #D98C7A with text #3F5350
no inconsistent lighting, no hard or doubled shadows
no brand name, wordmark, logo, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, coupon, shipping time
no absorbency multiples, dryness hours, breathability percentage, material composition
no age range, body weight, height chart, pack count
no certification, lab report, test standard number, origin claim, imported claim
no skin-care or rash-prevention medical wording
no recognizable baby face, no infant alone without an adult, no diaper-change action
style.presentationRules: product always fully inside frame, upright or flat-laid, stable centered scale, no cut-off base, vertical lines stay vertical, one real scale anchor in scene shots
style.surfaceSystem: quilted crawling-mat cotton with a fine stitch grid; the product itself keeps a smooth matte film face and a soft looped nonwoven face
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, headline and labels in #3F5350, one family only
